subject: Lane D Cycle 1 TEST: causal classifier discriminates failure gates and fails closed on ambiguity
body: Reduced source-shaped classifier executed against seven synthetic traces. It distinguished Shizuku death, stale-display use, capture-enter-without-return, surface/host failure, attached-without-useful-presentation, and useful-presentation success. An under-specified topology trace remained UNCLASSIFIED. MODEL evidence only.
falsification_rule: Missing post-call events alone cannot prove a synchronous crash; require uncaught-exception/process-death or trace-completeness evidence.
